U.note: Robust (persistence, live region, drift-free) but overbuilt, and the giant '0' pomodoro count outweighs the timer in the hierarchy.

V.note: Compact and correct, but the thick ring that barely depletes looks off, and there is no live region for screen readers.

W.note: Large monospace timer is clear, but it is padded with two reset buttons, confirm steps (paused reset did not reset in the scripted use) and long status prose.

X.note: Clean dark card with thin ring, tabs and settings; tidy, minimal code, though it has no aria-live and a weaker phone hierarchy than the best.

Y.note: Full-bleed red with a huge timer, a clear mode label, a live region and a sensible reset; strong at-a-glance read and a good phone layout.

Z.note: Polished navy design with a big timer, progress bar, cycle pips, keyboard shortcuts, live region and a clean pause state; slightly more than minimal but well judged.
